By utilizing crypto payments, creators can ensure that they receive the full value of their sales, without incurring significant transaction fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure typically involves a combination of free and paid tools, including hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and storage services like Supabase or Google Sheets. These tools work together to enable creators to host their digital products, process payments, and deliver products to customers automatically. The use of crypto payments, facilitated by services like NOWPayments, ensures that transactions are secure, reliable, and resistant to censorship.
